title: Towards 360$^\circ$ Embodied UAV Tracking Without Turning
abstract: arXiv:2611.33934v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Conventional embodied UAV tracking couples target observability with heading control because targets may leave the field of view of forward-facing cameras. We investigate a complementary paradigm that uses full-spherical perception to follow designated targets without active heading adjustment. To support this setting, we introduce 360UAV-ETrack, a simulation benchmark comprising 2,652 sequences, over 1.73 million synchronized observations, eight tracking tasks, and 150 held-out closed-loop scenarios. We propose 360UAV-TVLA, a panoramic vision--language--action (VLA) framework integrating persistent visual referring (PVR), compressed temporal memory (CTM), and geometry-aligned trajectory supervision (GTS) for instance identification, motion reasoning, and three-dimensional control. Experiments across two VLA backbones show consistent gains over standard fine-tuning, with normalized average tracking frames increasing from 22.56\% to 35.

translated_title: 迈向无需转向的360度具身无人机跟踪
translated_abstract: 传统的具身无人机跟踪将目标可观测性与航向控制耦合在一起，因为目标可能会离开前向相机的视野。我们研究了一种互补的范式，利用全向球面感知来跟踪指定目标，而无需主动调整航向。为支持这一设定，我们提出了360UAV-ETrack，一个仿真基准，包含2,652个序列、超过173万个同步观测数据、八项跟踪任务以及150个保留的闭环场景。我们进一步提出360UAV-TVLA，一个全景视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，集成了持久视觉指代（PVR）、压缩时序记忆（CTM）和几何对齐轨迹监督（GTS），用于实例识别、运动推理和三维控制。在两个VLA骨干网络上的实验表明，该方法相比标准微调取得了一致的性能提升，归一化平均跟踪帧数从22.56%提升至35.…（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出360UAV-ETrack仿真基准和360UAV-TVLA全景视觉-语言-动作框架，通过持久视觉指代、压缩时序记忆与几何对齐轨迹监督，利用全向球面感知实现无人机无需调整航向即可对指定目标进行360度持续跟踪。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes 360UAV-ETrack, a simulation benchmark, and 360UAV-TVLA, a panoramic vision-language-action framework with persistent visual referring, compressed temporal memory, and geometry-aligned trajectory supervision, enabling full-spherical perception-based UAV tracking of designated targets without active heading adjustment.
